correctness.rationale: Under normalized circle and area measures, homogeneous quadratic restriction is half of the evaluation functional at one on analytic polynomials of degree two. Phase, realification, reciprocal symmetrization and convexity reduce all complex triples to one real parameter. An elementary complete sign-integral and the unique root of tau=cos(tau) yield the sharp min 2tau/pi. The explicit symmetric polynomial attains it. The finite checker is supplementary, not a proof.

value.rationale: The homogeneous-degree-two subspace is the first nontrivial three-frequency model of a contemporary unresolved noncontractive p<2 diagonal operator. Its exact sharp norm is not just a sample witness: it solves the complete finite-dimensional extremal problem over complex triples, produces a strict lower bound exceeding the previously natural degree-one benchmark, and supplies a genuine mixed-term extremizer.
